description:
As a customer, I want to sort the products.

* Sorting should work properly.

cases.title: Products are reordered when a sorting option is applied
cases.preconditions: The product listing page is reachable and shows several products. The sorting options offered are not specified in the story.
steps: Note the current order of the products shown.
Select one of the sorting options offered by the application.
Observe the product list after the page refreshes/updates.
cases.expected: The product list is sorted according to the selected sorting option; every product in the list follows that order without exception. The exact sorting options and their ordering rules are not specified in the story.

cases.title: Each available sorting option sorts the list correctly
cases.preconditions: The product listing page is reachable and shows several products with differing values (e.g. different names and prices).
steps: Apply the first sorting option in the list of available options and check the resulting order of all products.
Repeat for every remaining sorting option offered, checking the resulting order each time.
cases.expected: For every sorting option, the products are displayed in the order that option indicates. The set of available sorting options is not specified in the story.

cases.title: Sorting a product list that contains no products
cases.preconditions: A product listing page that currently returns no products (for example an empty category or a search with no results).
steps: Open a product listing page that shows no products.
cases.expected: Applying sorting does not break the page; the empty list is still displayed. The exact behaviour and any message for an empty list is not specified in the story.

cases.title: Sorting a product list that contains exactly one product
cases.preconditions: A product listing page that returns exactly one product.
steps: Open the product listing page that shows exactly one product.
cases.expected: The single product remains displayed and the page continues to work after sorting is applied. No further behaviour for a one-item list is specified in the story.
